scenes: A computer has an edge: the boundary.
Everything that enters or leaves passes through Silo there.
Each way through is a channel: the network, ports, files, secrets, the screen, the clipboard, repository access.
None exists by default.
You add each one.
You set rules.
Silo keeps them outside the computer, and nothing inside can change them.
Rules that live inside an agent program are not a boundary: the agent can get around them.
When something reaches the boundary, one of three things happens.
It is allowed, and passes.
It is held, and waits for your answer.
Or it is denied, before anything passes.
Whatever no rule allows, and you have not said yes to, is denied.
A hold makes only one thing wait: the thing it is about.
The computer keeps running.
What you see is an ask.
Your yes is a grant.
The ask says exactly what it lets pass.
And a hold always ends.
If you do not answer, Silo ends it at its own limit.
The thing is denied, with an error the agent program can read.
If the agent program gives up first and closes its connection, Silo sees that too.
Rules have no order.
If one rule allows and another denies, deny wins.
Hold beats allow.
With no rule at all, it is denied.
So the order in which you wrote them never changes the result.
An alert is one more action, never a decision.
A rule that only alerts leaves the thing to the other rules.
A deny forbids one thing, and the computer keeps running.
Pause and stop act on the whole computer.
Pause freezes everything, nothing is lost, and you can resume.
Stop ends the programs that were running.
The disk stays.
Every action Silo can take has a kind.
Granting: the computer can do something it could not just before.
Destructive: it ends or erases something, and that cannot be undone.
Stop, restore and drop are here because each ends the programs that were running.
The disk is not lost.
Reversible: it grants nothing and destroys nothing.
A wrong one costs only time.
Two of these are still for you to agree: taking back a secret, and closing a network.
If they are reversible, a precaution can do them.
Anything added to Silo says the kind of each of its actions first.
